    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); comps=[]
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            if g[y][x] and (y,x) not in seen:
                c=g[y][x]; stack=[(y,x)]; cells=[]
                seen.add((y,x))
                while stack:
                    cy,cx=stack.pop(); cells.append((cy,cx))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=cy+dy,cx+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and (ny,nx) not in seen and g[ny][nx]==c:
                            seen.add((ny,nx)); stack.append((ny,nx))
                comps.append((c,cells))
    return comps

def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    comps=components(g)
    comps.sort(key=lambda t:(-max(x for y,x in t[1]), min(x for y,x in t[1])))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]

        best=0
        for s in range(1,W):
            if all(x+s<W and out[y][x+s]==0 for y,x in cells): best=s
            else: break
        for y,x in cells: out[y][x+best]=c
    return out
